decisions.rationale: The pinned server source independently confirms that its setup route emits board_setup-plan plan_initialization_call arguments with every field, including board_id, set to null. The candidate rejects that exact server-returned call before its existing full route comparison. This blocks the retained setup workflow, while the proposed one-condition repair preserves exact non-null board identity and the stricter all-null route comparison. The demonstrated functionality impact materially outweighs the small implementation and regression risk.
decisions.smallest_fix: In FirmwareAcceptanceController._validate_route_pre_dispatch, apply the generic retained board_id equality check only to non-null board_id arguments. Preserve the existing exact board_setup-plan all-null route comparison and every non-null route check.
